issues.detail: The Hebrew 'בֶּעָשׂוֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ' means 'on the tenth day of the month', but the Chinese renders it as '十弦琴之月的第十日' (the tenth day of the ten-stringed-lute month), incorrectly interpreting 'עָשׂוֹר' (tenth) as a musical instrument (ten-stringed lute). This changes the meaning of the date.
